extension.summary: P2PBG torrent streaming via Elementum (with VPN gate)
extension.description: Search p2pbg.com torrents and stream them through the Elementum engine, with a fail-closed VPN country gate before playback.
extension.disclaimer: Requires an Elementum installation for torrent streaming and a p2pbg.com account. This add-on stores your tracker credentials only in local Kodi settings.
